name: Voxel
summary: A value on a regular 3D grid: the volume version of a pixel. A world of voxels is built, lit and changed cell by cell.
how: Fix one cell size for the whole world, for example 1 m.
Keep every surface on the grid; no free rotation.
Light each cell by the light level of its neighbours.

origin.note: Comanche draws its terrain with the Voxel Space engine.

adoptions.via: Infiniminer and Minecraft build whole worlds from cube cells.
